items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: Well he didn't give me no book, he just, he written me out scales.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's right. Yeah, that's was wonderful times then. When I first came down here we used to, when I did start to go in Goodwill, things were pretty good. That's in the 20s, early 20s. Well in 26 I was playing with Chris Keller.
Well can you tell us a little bit, before you get there about your lessons with Dave Perkins, what he taught you, what kind of a book you used or anything else you can remember about your lessons?

Well he didn't give me no book, he just, he written me out scales. I learned them and what the hardest part about it was to them, that time, I had to keep time like, . Yeah, slide the grip to the door and bring it up on the board. Yeah, that's indeed. He's, instead of me, he's watching my notes and saying I'll be watching my feet trying to get that together. Yeah. Well he, he gave me a pretty good eye there on me, but I didn't finish too much on him because I wasn't able, because he was charging a dollar a…
